title: Enchanted Bananas and Bats
description: A woman in an ornate cream and gold Renaissance-style dress sits on a stone windowsill, gazing upward at three glowing purple bats with green faces and mischievous grins. A golden birdcage containing one bat sits beside a large bunch of bananas labeled 'BANANAS' that drip purple liquid, surrounded by an aurora borealis visible through a stone window, hanging vines, and mystical forest elements.
prompt: A beautiful woman in an ornate cream and gold historical dress sits on a stone ledge inside a mystical stone chamber, looking up at glowing purple bats with evil grins and green faces flying near her. One bat is inside a golden birdcage. A large bunch of yellow bananas with the word BANANAS in white sits on the ledge dripping purple liquid. Through a large window behind her is a vibrant green and pink aurora borealis over a dark forest. Hanging vines, lavender flowers, and twisted roots surround the scene in a highly detailed, whimsical fantasy style.
